greet.text: Camp rations are bark tea and yesterday's bread. A man my age dreams of exactly one thing: a proper pie, still warm from a real oven.

effects.missingText: You carry no pie, and now we're both sadder for it. Cook Mabel at Ironhold bakes them, for an egg and some honey.
effects.successText: He eats half of it in reverent silence and wraps the rest for tomorrow. 'Worth every crystal.' 50, gladly.

choices.label: I'll see what I can do.

greet.text: Forage's thin this season and the wolves get bold when a man walks hungry. Smoked fish keeps for weeks — the Saltmere market strings them by the dozen.

effects.missingText: You've no smoked fish on you. The Fish Market in Saltmere Port strings them fresh from the smoker.
effects.successText: He tucks it into his pack like treasure. 'That's a week of walking safe. 25 crystals, friend.'

greet.text: Look at the state of these boots — more hole than leather. The capital's tailor sells sturdy ones, if you ever pass through. I'd pay well over the asking price to save myself the trip.

choices.label: I have a pair of sturdy boots right here.

effects.missingText: Unless you're hiding them under that cloak, you don't. Pell's Tailoring, in the capital — sturdy boots, ask for the ones with the double-stitched soles.
effects.successText: Ha! Perfect fit. You've saved me a week's walk and my last good pair of socks. Here — 90 crystals, and cheap at the price.

quests.title: Embers Low
quests.offerDialogue: The fire's down to embers and my knees are too old for hauling. There are three piles of cut wood out by the treeline — bring them in and the camp stays warm another week.
quests.activeDialogue: Three wood piles, out by the treeline. Mind the brambles.
quests.completeDialogue: Good haul. The fire will see out the week now. Sit a while if you like — the camp's yours as much as mine.

quests.title: Feed the Flame
quests.offerDialogue: The wood's stacked but the fire's still just a flicker — needs a proper log fed to it, not just kindling. There's log piles right here by the fire. Feed one to the flames and see what catches.
quests.activeDialogue: Feed a log to the campfire, right here at the heart of camp, and build it back to a proper blaze.
quests.completeDialogue: Feel that heat? That's a fire now, not an apology for one. You've done the camp a real service.

quests.title: Charcoal for the Forge
quests.offerDialogue: That fire's finally burning hot enough to leave good char behind. Rake some out and bring it here — I've an anvil going cold for want of it.
quests.activeDialogue: Bring Bram the charcoal raked from the roaring campfire.
quests.completeDialogue: Good, clean char — burns hot and even. My anvil thanks you, and so do I.

collectible.name: Forge Token
collectible.desc: A small iron token Bram presses into your hand. 'First charcoal off that fire in years,' he says. 'Worth marking.'

quests.title: Shiny Stones
quests.offerDialogue: The old warding-scarecrow's arm points at the scree where the ridge came down. Among the rubble, three stones catch the light — odd, smooth, and warm to the touch. Mott did say he needed such stones to shift the blockage...
quests.activeDialogue: Gather the three shiny stones from the fallen scree, then bring them to Forager Mott.
quests.completeDialogue:
These three? Aye — keystones, my gran called them. Watch.

*Mott wedges them into the pile; with a groan the rocks roll aside and the path up to the fire opens.*

There. Camp's yours, traveller. Go tell Rell I made it.

collectible.name: Warm Keystone
collectible.desc: A smooth stone from the Thornwood ridge-fall, oddly warm. Mott swears they hold a wall together better than mortar.

quests.title: Lost Along the Treeline
quests.offerDialogue: Two days stuck out here and I dropped half my pack fleeing a wolf — a journal, my wife's pendant, a flask of something that helped the nights pass. They're scattered up the treeline now the path's clear. Find them?
quests.activeDialogue: Recover Mott's journal, pendant, and flask from along the treeline.
quests.completeDialogue: My journal, the pendant, AND the flask — you wonderful soul. The pendant most of all; she'd have had my hide. Here, you've earned this and more.

quests.title: Forage the Hollow
quests.offerDialogue: The pot's thin and the woods are thick with good eating, if you know a meal from a poison. Three baskets of bracket-caps from the old stumps — gather them and the camp eats well tonight.
quests.activeDialogue: Gather three baskets of mushrooms from the stumps around the camp.
quests.completeDialogue: Bracket-caps, every one, and not a death-cap among them — you've a forager's eye. Stew for everyone. Sit, eat your share.

quests.title: The Wolf Watch
quests.offerDialogue: Wolves crept to the woodpile last night. We keep them off with wolfsbane bundles set along the treeline, but mine's gone to dust. Gather three fresh bundles where the herb grows wild.
quests.activeDialogue: Gather three bundles of wolfsbane from along the treeline for Ranger Sable.
quests.completeDialogue: Good and pungent — that'll wrinkle a wolf's nose from a hundred paces. I'll set them at dusk. The watch is easier with another pair of hands.

quests.title: A Word to the Warden
quests.offerDialogue: Wards are set, but Rell keeps the night roster and he'll want to know the pack's moved south. There's a warding-draught brewed by the scarecrow post — carry it and my word up to the fire. Tell him: wolves, southside, bold.
quests.activeDialogue: Carry the warding-draught and Sable's report up to Warden Rell at the fire.
quests.completeDialogue: Southside, is it? Bold indeed. I'll double the night watch and thank Sable for the draught. And you — you've quick feet and a steady hand. The camp's lucky you wandered in.

quests.title: The Snare Line
quests.offerDialogue: A camp lives on what the snares catch. Three of mine were sprung and the catch carried off — gather the sacks and re-bag what's left before the crows finish the job.
quests.activeDialogue: Collect the three sprung snare-sacks from around the camp for Warden Rell.
quests.completeDialogue: Enough for a few good suppers, and the snares can be reset. You're worth your keep twice over. Take this — and there's always a place at the fire.

quests.title: A Traveller's Aid
quests.offerDialogue: Bandits lightened my pack on the Ironhold road — took my road-rations clean. Berries, a flask, a basket of trail-bread from the camp stores: help me restock and I'll not be a corpse by the river come morning.
quests.activeDialogue: Gather berries, a flask, and a basket of trail-bread to restock Trader Pell's pack.
quests.completeDialogue: Restocked and road-worthy — you've quite literally saved my skin. Now, about that parcel for Ravenwatch...

quests.title: The Ravenwatch Parcel
quests.offerDialogue: My legs won't make Ravenwatch before the bandits make me. But yours might. This parcel's promised to Innkeeper Rosie at the Ravenwatch inn — sealed goods, paid for. Carry it true and she'll see you right. Mind the river road.
quests.activeDialogue: Carry Trader Pell's sealed parcel to Innkeeper Rosie at the Ravenwatch inn.
quests.completeDialogue: Pell's parcel, all the way from Thornwood! He's a good sort, that one — and so are you for braving the river road. Here's your fee, with the inn's thanks.

collectible.name: Relay Token
collectible.desc: A trader's token marking a parcel run from Thornwood Camp to Ravenwatch. Pell remembers a reliable courier.

quests.title: Bramble's Buried Hoard
quests.offerDialogue: *Bramble paws the dirt and looks up at you, then at three suspicious mounds around the camp. The message is clear: dig, human. DIG.*
quests.activeDialogue: Dig up the three things Bramble buried around the camp.
quests.completeDialogue: *Bramble inspects the recovered hoard — a shiny pebble, a crow's feather, another pebble — and decides you are now Best Friend. A cold nose to the hand seals the pact.*
